summary: Diff adds a Motoko backend actor with user profiles, product CRUD scaffolding, and (truncated) sales recording plus a new React frontend implementing Internet Identity login gating, onboarding dialog, dashboard UI (daily summary + low-stock alerts), product and sales UI components, and a green-themed Tailwind design. Some additional access-control/admin-token plumbing and Caffeine branding appear that were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-token/secret-based access-control initialization flow (URL param `caffeineAdminToken` and `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`)
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires Internet Identity authentication and explicitly disallows non-II auth methods; it does not request an additional secret-token admin bootstrap mechanism.
evidence: backend/main.mo (imports `authorization/...`, includes `MixinAuthorization(accessControlState)`; actor init call referenced via `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` in frontend)

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai promotional footer/branding link and tracking parameters
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request adding third-party branding/attribution links in the app UI.

hallucinated_features.description: Custom authorization subsystem modules (`authorization/MixinAuthorization`, `authorization/access-control`) layered on top of II login
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested explicitly; BuildRequest only asks to gate features behind II-authenticated sessions. The diff introduces a role/permission system beyond that scope.
